updateNotes: V2-tv Beta, fourth update. New: Nura's own on-screen keyboard for Search on the TV (Guide, Movies, Series, Home), and a Test your remote page in Settings > Remote Control. Better: the Guide scrolls more smoothly when you tap Up/Down, a sharper-looking Guide, Multi-view opens faster and its channel list starts with real channels. Fixed: long programme titles no longer push the Watch and Start over buttons out of the panel, and Multi-view no longer drops you out after closing the channel list.
